description:
Real-time Google web search (SERP). Organic results, knowledge panels, AI Overviews and AI Mode answers for any query.

Operations (set "operation" to one of these; put its parameters in "args"):
- search_light (required: q): Search Light
- search (required: q): Search
- search_by_url (required: url): Search by URL
- ai_mode (required: prompt): AI Mode
- people_also_ask (required: q): People Also Ask
- search_light_bulk (required: queries): Search Light Bulk

When to use: Use for general web/Google searches. For news specifically use realtime_news_data; for autocomplete suggestions use web_search_autocomplete; for Bing results use realtime_bing_search_data.

args.description: Parameters for the chosen operation as key/value pairs (see the tool description for required params).

operation.description: Which endpoint to call. See the tool description for each operation and its parameters.

name: realtime_web_search
